name: Content, open letter
description: A dated letter on a stacked paper card with a salutation, body and handwritten-style signature.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: To every team that still writes forty-page research reports

fields.name: body
fields.label: Letter
fields.default:
We know how much care goes into those reports. We wrote them too: the late nights, the perfect chart, the appendix nobody opens.

Here is what we learned the hard way. Decisions rarely change because of a summary. They change when someone hears a customer say it in their own words, with the pause and the sigh still in it.

So this year, try something smaller. Send one clip instead of one chapter. Let the customer do the convincing. We think you will be surprised by how quickly the room listens.

fields.name: signoff
fields.label: Sign-off
fields.default: With respect and a lot of coffee,
